reuse.why: Uses the existing RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers, but copies getUpcomingDates' occurrence-to-adjusted-day pipeline instead of extracting it for both handlers.

duplication.why: The filter/map chain that skips daily weekend occurrences and moves the others is a near-verbatim copy of getUpcomingDates in the same file, as is the try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper.

placement.why: A new handler in schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates fits the tree, though the weekend-adjustment pipeline arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts beside the helpers it composes.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two copies of the occurrence adjustment now have to be kept in step (and already diverge on the weekendSolveMode default), and the ±3 day window is a magic margin tied to that logic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: It calls the existing weekend helpers isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the issue is a copied pipeline, not a bypassed abstraction.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts repeats getUpcomingDates' filter/map chain almost verbatim (only the lambda variable name and a default differ), an open copy rather than a disguised one.
